Chart rubric

1 · Trend (Minervini Trend Template). Price above the 150- and 200-day; 150 above 200; 200-day rising ≥1 month; 50-day above both; price above the 50-day; ≥30% above the 52-week low; within 25% of the 52-week high; outperforming the S&P 500. Stage 2 = ≥6/8, with price above the 200-day and the 50-day above the 200-day.

2 · Pattern (O'Neil/IBD; Bulkowski). Flat base (≥5 wks, ≤15% deep) · Cup with handle (≥7 wks, 12–35% deep, U-shaped; handle ≤12% in the upper half) · Double bottom (lows within ~5%, ≥3 wks apart) · Ascending triangle · Bull / high-tight flag · VCP (shrinking pullbacks, drying volume) · Pullback to a rising 50-day.

3 · Status vs pivot. Breakout (close above on ≥1.4x volume, ≤5% past) · At pivot (≤5% below) · At support · Forming (5–10% below) · Extended (>5% past, don't chase).

Verdict. PASS = Stage 2 + valid pattern at breakout, pivot or support · WATCH = forming/extended or near-miss trend · FAIL = no valid pattern, downtrend, failed breakout. A script proposes patterns; every chart is verified by eye.

How to read the charts: candles = daily price; orange = 50-day, gray = 150-day, purple = 200-day average; red dashed line = verified pivot (buy point); bottom panel = volume.
